text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to amend the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Bessarion Road, between Caracas Road and a point 35 metres north, to a stopping prohibition in effect at all times. The proposed stopping prohibition will promote clear sight lines for eastbound left-turning motorists at the intersection of Bessarion Road and Caracas Road.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Bessarion Road, between Caracas Road and a point 35 metres north. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on the west side of Bessarion Road, between Caracas Road and a point 35 metres north.
